title: An on-chip AXI traffic generator and protocol checker
tagline: A block beside the design under test that drives AXI4-Lite and AXI4-Stream traffic from a program loaded at run time and checks named protocol rules in hardware

facts.text: A hardware checker flagged the expected rule in all 6 runs with a seeded protocol bug (8 faults) on the Nexys A7; AMD's own AXI Protocol Checker on the same AXI4-Lite bus gave the same verdict in all 17 runs.
On our own test peripheral and stream FIFO, the board's traffic matched the simulation cycle for cycle in 13 of 13 runs, with 0 differences in 936 logged transactions.
The checker is checked formally to 20 clock cycles (bounded): 32 of 32 properties hold, and 53 of 53 deliberately broken copies of it are caught.

media.alt: A waveform captured on the board, replayed cycle by cycle: after the address handshake the peripheral raises BVALID, its write response, before any write data; the checker's B_EARLY rule (a response before its data) goes high, and the write data arrives only afterwards.
media.note: Recorded from the showcase page's own hero (results/59a_axi_tx/hero.json) by axi_tx/portfolio_capture.js.

status: Measured on the board; full AXI4, the slave side and long soak runs are planned next.
